content:
It’s been just over a year since Apple released AirPods Pro 3, and I can confidently say I’ve worn them every day since. After a year of heavy use, I’m even more convinced that AirPods Pro 3 are the best money you can spend on Apple gear (especially at current sale pricing).

  • Buy AirPods Pro 3: $149 (Reg. $249)

AirPods Pro 3: The best

While the changes to AirPods Pro 3 fit have been controversial to some users, I’ve been thoroughly impressed over the last year. I find them incredibly comfortable, and I absolutely notice the improvement in noise cancellation enabled by the updated in-ear fit. The sound quality, of course, is also excellent, and is made better by the updated shape.

One feature I haven’t found myself using (or noticing) very often is the heart rate sensor. This is probably because I always wear an Apple Watch. Apple says that AirPods Pro 3 and Apple Watch can work together to get you the most accurate heart rate data possible. I assume this happens in the background, but I never notice or think about it.

An interesting twist to AirPods Pro 3 is that they actually have worse battery life on paper than AirPods Pro 2.

  • AirPods Pro 2, 30 hours total: 24 hours from the case and six hours from the buds
  • AirPods Pro 3, 24 hours total: 16 hours from the case and eight hours from the buds

I haven’t noticed the overall lower battery life at all. On long travel days, however, I absolutely appreciate the longer battery life from the buds themselves. I can now comfortably wear them from my departure airport to my arrival airport on most travel days. And I don’t have any issues just placing my AirPods Pro 3 on a Qi charger on my desk to refuel.

And they keep getting better

One thing I love about AirPods is that they continuously get better with software updates. AirPods Pro 3 are no different. In addition to bug fixes and performance improvements, here are some of the new features that have come to AirPods Pro 2 since they were released:

  • Custom EQ: lets you adjust low, mid, and high frequencies to your liking
  • Redesigned AirPods settings: splits the settings screen into clearer categories and submenus
  • GymKit heart rate sync (AirPods Pro 3 only): sends heart rate from AirPods Pro 3 to compatible treadmills, ellipticals, and bikes through your iPhone
  • Precision Finding on Apple Watch: guides you to your AirPods Pro 3 from your Apple Watch using the case’s UWB chip

Wrap up

Here’s what I wrote in my AirPods Pro 3 review last year:

I often tell people that AirPods are the best bang-for-your-buck product in Apple’s lineup. They’re one of my most-used Apple products, and I’m sure I could do some math to prove they have the lowest cost-per-use of anything I own. AirPods Pro 3 are the best $249 you can spend with Apple today, and they feel like a turning point in what we should expect from the category going forward.

One year later, I stand by this paragraph. Also, note that I wrote $249 in that paragraph. Right now, AirPods Pro 3 are on sale for $149. That is an absolutely absurd value. If you’re on the fence, there’s never been a better time to join the AirPods Pro 3 club.
